Name: Entrance to Narnia (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
I think the PIF framework absolutely asks for making a Narnia mod, so here it is! This is not a full on expansion though, it's just a small cute map that looks like the entry to Narnia complete with lamp post and wintery forest scenery. While the default option is eternal winter, you can also make it follow the normal seasons in which case it will function similar to my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25435]Backyard [/url]mod. To make it a bit more useful in winter, I added a bunch of renewable stumps. If you have SH's wild animals ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21231]lite[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063]normal[/url]) installed, beavers will spawn in the woods sometimes as well. No Mr. Tumnus though, since I have no experience with custom NPCs and am also not sure how that would work in a PIF location.

I also added four wardrobes as furniture items which do not function as dressers, but will work as PIF doors. While the wardrobes are meant to go with the Narnia map, you can also use them for any other PIF map and of course you can access Narnia through a normal PIF door as well.

The map does NOT expand with farmhouse upgrades.

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*]Eternal winter (optional, you can enable normal seasons in the config but it will require a restart of the game)
[*]Narnia lamp post
[*]Dynamic background
[*]Respawning stumps
[*]Beaver companions if you have have SH's wild animals installed
[*]4 wardrobes that act like PIF doors (buy it from the magician in the bus stop tunnel or get it from the furniture catalogue)
[*]Farmable and buildable land
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
Should be compatible with everything that PIF is compatible with. For recolours turn off the seasonal lamp post. Note that with the eternal winter option enabled, some recolours (for example VPR) may be buggy and their changes not applied due to the way these recolours load their changes based on what season it is in the main world. There is nothing I can do to change that.
[b]
Credits[/b]
Huge thanks to DeLiXx for adding the option to override seasons in PIF on my request!

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI,
Content Patcher and Personal Indoor Farm. 1.6. is required.
